newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China fertilizer producer to list 117 mln A share.
newsitem.headline: China fertilizer producer to list 117 mln A share.

text.p: China's fertilizer producer Shenzhen Liaohe Tongda Chemical Industry Co Ltd will list 117 million A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange by the end of this month, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
Tongda expects to list the stock on January 30, but the precise date will be decided by the Shenzhen exchange, he said.
The offer, launched on the Shenzhen bourse at 5.38 yuan per share earlier this month, was completed and oversubscribed 47.8 times, he told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin.
The company simultaneously issued 13 million staff shares at the same price, which will not be listed until six months after the flotation of the A shares, the official said.
In a prospectus, the firm said it would use funds from the offers to buy 96 percent of the Liaoning-based Jinxi Natural Gas Chemical Plant to expand Tongda's fertilizer making capacity.

Tongda is headquartered in Shenzhen but its production facilities are in northeastern Liaoning province. It currently has total share capital of 615 million shares, composed of 450.11 million state shares, 34.89 million legal person shares, 117 million A shares and 13 million staff shares, he said.
Tongda forecast 1997 net profits of 357.98 million yuan, up from 220.93 million yuan last year and 158.90 million in 1995.
